name: Segasaki Mao
source:
Strong-willed and fastidious, the president of a design company who is strict with others but does her work really well. This time, in order to cover up the traffic accident caused by her sister Mio, she does not call an ambulance for Naoki, and instead, hides him in her own home, planning to keep the accident hidden. Her selfishness and one-sided arguments eventually get on his nerves, so he rapes her against her will. She resists at first, but due to the fear of losing her social status, she leaves herself at his mercy.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1237580]Getchu[/url]]
